data.name: Isac
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew name 'Yitzchak' meaning 'he who laughs', this name is given to boys in the Bible and in Christian traditions. It was bestowed upon the son of Abraham and Sarah, who was considered a miracle birth due to their old age. The name is associated with God's promise to reward Abraham and Sarah with a child.
